entities.name: Diego de Covarubias y Leyva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Diego de Covarrubias y Leyva was a Spanish jurist and Roman Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Cuenca (1577-1577), Archbishop of Segovia (1564-1577), Archbishop of Ciudad Rodrigo (1560-1564), and Archbishop of Santo Domingo (1556-1560).
